notes:
Nocto 0.7.0: editor menus, linked audio, scene and profile sharing, OBS import
- Video editor: right-click menus, separate audio from video with linked audio clips, waveforms and frame thumbnails
- Export and import scenes (.nocto-scenes) and your full profile (.nocto-profile, stream keys are never included)
- Import OBS Studio scene collections with an import report
- Linux AppImage: proper icon and AppStream metadata
- Windows x64, ARM64 and Linux builds otherwise behave as in 0.6.0

linux-x64.label: Linux
linux-x64.requirements: Linux x86_64 (Wayland or X11, PipeWire, Mesa 24+ or NVIDIA driver)
linux-x64.install:
Install: download the AppImage, then run chmod +x Nocto-0.7.3-x86_64.AppImage and start it with ./Nocto-0.7.3-x86_64.AppImage.

Needs: a Wayland or X11 desktop with PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal, and your distribution's GPU drivers (Mesa 24+ for Intel/AMD, or the NVIDIA proprietary driver). Recommended: GStreamer plugins-base and plugins-good for browser source audio; the v4l2loopback camera driver for the virtual camera in Discord/Zoom (Nocto offers a one-click setup with your desktop's password dialog, no terminal needed). Updates install from inside Nocto after this version (checksum verified, with automatic rollback); if you are on 0.7.2 or older, download this one manually once.
linux-x64.notes:
Nocto 0.7.3 (Linux): Window Capture now works via a "Choose window..." picker; Display/Window Capture properties can reopen the picker; AppImage self-update with checksum verification, backup and automatic rollback
- Linux only: Windows stays on 0.7.0
- If you are on 0.7.2 or older, download this version manually once
